intro: Invoices are made from trips. Add trips first — then the invoice fills itself.

steps.title: Add your cars & clients
steps.line: Add the cars you run and the companies you bill.

steps.title: Add trips (duties)
steps.line: Record every duty: date, car, client, km and hours.

steps.title: Make the invoice
steps.line: Pick a client and month. Their trips come in by themselves. Add toll, state tax and parking.

steps.title: Share & get paid
steps.line: Download or share the PDF, then mark it paid when the money comes.
